source_gap_claims.behavior: Require current independent review and scoped approval before the Acceptance lifecycle owner publishes acceptance-passed.
source_gap_claims.reason: The obligations restrict who may publish, but do not require the stated review and approval prerequisites.
source_gap_claims.subject: Acceptance publication prerequisites

source_gap_claims.behavior: Before using a validator source outside the historical root, obtain a frozen, independent Trust Approval from existing authority that binds exact source, content, complete dependency closure, support policy, and scope.
source_gap_claims.reason: The obligations call for independent trust verification but do not establish this conditional approval and timing rule.
source_gap_claims.subject: Alternate validator source

source_gap_claims.behavior: Verify that Candidate contains the real change under evaluation.
source_gap_claims.reason: The obligations require Candidate execution and immutability but do not establish its relationship to the real change.
source_gap_claims.subject: Candidate Package eligibility

source_gap_claims.behavior: Require the six Matrix Cases to cover the specified valid-package, invalid-package, historical-compatibility, dirty-baseline, knowledge-read-set-collision, and closed-policy architecture-index scenarios.
source_gap_claims.reason: The obligations require six materially distinct cases but do not require these specific scenarios.
source_gap_claims.subject: Closed Replay Matrix

source_gap_claims.behavior: Freeze a version-bound, non-empty Consumer Manifest before review.
source_gap_claims.reason: Bidirectional reconciliation establishes caller coverage but does not freeze the manifest or bind its version before review.
source_gap_claims.subject: Consumer Manifest

source_gap_claims.behavior: Approve and bind any Consumer or transition non-applicability exception before execution; do not let an implementation declare its own omission.
source_gap_claims.reason: The obligations apply to every applicable Consumer but do not govern how exceptions become applicable.
source_gap_claims.subject: Consumer applicability exceptions

source_gap_claims.behavior: Bind each Consumer observation to its actual interface, input, command, output, result, and dependencies.
source_gap_claims.reason: The obligations require real Consumer calls and some Replay Result checks, but not these bindings for each Consumer observation.
source_gap_claims.subject: Consumer observations

source_gap_claims.behavior: Bind each Probe to its actual target, command, and result as well as its input and output.
source_gap_claims.reason: The Probe obligations bind inputs and outputs and require real processes; they do not bind these additional execution identities per Probe.
source_gap_claims.subject: Detached Probes

source_gap_claims.behavior: During disable, make a real Consumer call to the Prior Route and reproduce its identity, verdict, and diagnostic category for every applicable fixture.
source_gap_claims.reason: The obligations require a real disable operation and eventual baseline restoration, but do not specify this disable-stage observation.
source_gap_claims.subject: Disable transition

source_gap_claims.behavior: Bind each evaluation seed to native evidence identity and reject missing or drifted seed evidence.
source_gap_claims.reason: The seed obligations require provenance and metadata, but not native evidence identity or seed-specific drift validation.
source_gap_claims.subject: Evaluation-seed evidence

source_gap_claims.behavior: Restrict seed classifications to anchor_candidate, challenge_candidate, or non_baseline_exploratory_candidate, and prevent evaluation-set admission within TC-D1.
source_gap_claims.reason: Approved non-baseline classification does not enforce the closed classification set or the separate evaluation-set restriction.
source_gap_claims.subject: Evaluation-seed status

source_gap_claims.behavior: Give every behavioral Atomic Obligation its own observable fault witness and every other Atomic Obligation a deterministic violation witness.
source_gap_claims.reason: Required-witness coverage is specified, but the complete obligation set does not impose these witness types or independence.
source_gap_claims.subject: Exact Cover witnesses

source_gap_claims.behavior: Use measured full-matrix, Consumer, and rollback timing to set process and aggregate budgets before implementation authorization.
source_gap_claims.reason: Bounded time and output are covered, but measurement and the authorization deadline are not.
source_gap_claims.subject: Execution budget selection

source_gap_claims.behavior: Reproduce diagnostic categories and required identity and evidence relationships from the same pinned inputs.
source_gap_claims.reason: The obligations reproduce the terminal semantic verdict and Exact Cover, but omit these additional Semantic Reproduction components.
source_gap_claims.subject: Fresh-checkout Semantic Reproduction

source_gap_claims.behavior: Produce fresh process evidence for a current equivalent historical replay and state the boundary of equivalence.
source_gap_claims.reason: Historical immutability and fresh replay reproducibility do not require this historical-equivalence observation or its stated limits.
source_gap_claims.subject: Historical equivalent replay

source_gap_claims.behavior: Freeze each Matrix Case expectation before execution; accept an expected-difference only for its frozen case when execution and evidence gates pass, without approving a regression.
source_gap_claims.reason: The obligations cover case execution and evidence validity but contain no expectation or regression rule.
source_gap_claims.subject: Matrix Case expectations

source_gap_claims.behavior: Reject an aggregate whose Matrix Case has an undeclared diagnostic category.
source_gap_claims.reason: The matrix evidence obligations reject several invalid evidence conditions, but none addresses undeclared diagnostics.
source_gap_claims.subject: Matrix aggregate

source_gap_claims.behavior: Check each Matrix Case's invariants and verify preserved behavior in unaffected cases.
source_gap_claims.reason: Two-sided execution with distinct inputs and attributable evidence does not establish invariant or non-regression checks.
source_gap_claims.subject: Matrix comparison

source_gap_claims.behavior: Establish real defect-revealing tests before production behavior changes; use truthful characterization and a distinct fault witness for existing passing behavior.
source_gap_claims.reason: The supplied obligations require Exact Cover witnesses but do not impose this pre-change test order or reject fabricated RED evidence.
source_gap_claims.subject: Production change verification

source_gap_claims.behavior: Reject writes to installed BMAD/GDS paths and Phase, runtime, Hosted workspace, account, and sandbox paths during this repair.
source_gap_claims.reason: Historical artifact immutability and evidence append rules do not cover these protected implementation paths.
source_gap_claims.subject: Protected path boundaries

source_gap_claims.behavior: Verify exact original input identities before producing fresh replay evidence.
source_gap_claims.reason: Fresh-checkout reproduction and complete snapshot binding do not impose this ordering and pre-execution identity check.
source_gap_claims.subject: Replay reconstruction

source_gap_claims.behavior: Use the specified terminal result categories and prevent serialized aliases from merging failures into success or silently changing category meanings.
source_gap_claims.reason: Deterministic terminal states are required, but the obligation set does not define the categories or alias compatibility rule.
source_gap_claims.subject: Replay terminal results

source_gap_claims.behavior: During rollback, make a real Consumer call to the Prior Route and reproduce its identity, verdict, and diagnostic category for every applicable fixture.
source_gap_claims.reason: The obligations require behavioral rollback and a baseline observation after rollback, but do not require this per-fixture Prior Route call and comparison.
source_gap_claims.subject: Rollback transition

source_gap_claims.behavior: Allow portable-field exclusions only under a reviewed, approved, versioned policy that cannot hide semantic, target, evidence-validity, or authority inputs; make dependent results stale when that policy changes.
source_gap_claims.reason: The obligations address unexplained result-determining drift but do not govern exclusion policy approval, scope, or change invalidation.
source_gap_claims.subject: Snapshot normalization policy

source_gap_claims.behavior: Verify that Stable represents source-supported existing behavior with provenance bound before execution, and reject a temporary package offered as Stable solely because it differs from Candidate.
source_gap_claims.reason: Stable immutability and execution are covered; Stable eligibility and provenance are not.
source_gap_claims.subject: Stable Package eligibility

source_gap_claims.behavior: Keep the validator source inside its approved root and reject candidate selection or substitution of that source.
source_gap_claims.reason: Independent source and candidate-external trust verification do not expressly enforce the approved-root and candidate-selection restrictions.
source_gap_claims.subject: Validator source selection
